result.title: MATA: Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter
result.comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. Joint first authors with equal contributions. Code - https://github.com/prakashchhipa/MATA-Motion-aligned-Temporal-Adapter
result.summary: Few-shot fine-grained video action recognition requires recognizing novel action classes from only a few labeled examples. The difficulty is that visually similar actions often share actors, scenes, poses, and objects, differing only in the order, timing, and short duration of motion changes. We study this problem under three practical constraints: few tunable parameters, low compute cost, and use of the video modality alone. We propose Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter (MATA), a parameter-efficient adapter on top of a frozen CLIP backbone. MATA specializes CLIP features along the temporal dimension using two components: temporal phase alignment through learnable temporal positional embeddings, and a local motion transition operator through depth-wise convolution. With only ~3.6M tunable parameters, MATA achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple fine-grained benchmarks while remaining robust to both visual corruptions and temporal disruptions induced by frame dropping. Code is available at https://github.com/prakashchhipa/MATA-Motion-aligned-Temporal-Adapter

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MATA，在冻结 CLIP 上挂接仅约 3.6M 参数的时间适配器，用可学习时间位置嵌入做相位对齐、用深度可分离卷积建模局部运动转移，以提升少样本细粒度视频动作识别。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以轻量时间位置嵌入和局部卷积向冻结视觉特征注入时序与运动线索，可能可供核查多帧视觉 token 进入 latent 推理状态时的时间顺序编码，但论文本身不做 latent 推理、证据筛选或停止决策。
